name: Daedalus
description_long: Open-source full-node desktop wallet for ada. Unlike light wallets, Daedalus runs a Cardano node locally and independently validates the entire chain, so users never rely on third-party servers and can submit transactions directly to the mempool even during network congestion. Includes hierarchical deterministic multi-wallet management, Ledger and Trezor hardware wallet support, DRep voting delegation, and Mithril-based fast sync that reduces initial synchronisation from days to minutes. Runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Originally built by IOG; since 2026 maintained by Se7en Labs, funded through a Cardano treasury withdrawal.
